title: Finance
subtitle: Give {productName} your figures as line items. Margins, growth, runway, breakeven, and NPV are computed in code; the model only writes the narrative, and any figure it cannot trace is removed.
parseHint: Nothing is computed until you confirm the rows below.
emptyWait: Add figures, confirm the line items, then describe the brief.
promptPlaceholder: Describe a finance brief… (cash plan, breakeven, exposure)

params.discountRatePercentHint: Enables NPV / IRR over cash line items by period
params.fixedCostsHint: With price and variable cost, enables breakeven

preview.guardOk: Every figure in this brief traces to a line item or a computed metric.
preview.guardFlagged: {count} figure(s) the model wrote could not be traced to your inputs or the computed metrics and were replaced with “[unverified figure]”: {figures}.

errors.stub: Finance needs a live gateway. Paste a Toko Token API key in Settings, then try again.
errors.addItems: Add line items first: paste figures and parse them, add rows by hand, or pick a saved dataset.
errors.parseInvalidJson: Model returned invalid JSON for the figures
errors.parseEmpty: No figures could be read from that text
errors.docx: Could not build the DOCX file
errors.emptyBrief: Model returned an empty finance brief

errors.itemsRequired: items are required. Parse the pasted figures first and confirm them.
errors.itemsInvalid: items must be a non-empty list of line items with a label and a numeric amount
errors.datasetNoAmounts: That dataset has no numeric column to use as amounts
errors.bodyRequired: Request body must be a JSON object

pipeline.languageInstruction: Write the title, section headings, body paragraphs, and assumptions in English. Keep JSON keys in English. Do not translate metric keys. Keep every number exactly as given.
